title: Hardware Debloat Ghidra plugin
highlights: Recursive tracing with a depth limit over the control-flow graph.
Indirect and computed calls are handled by over-approximation.
Exports control-flow graphs that DECAF's enforcement plugin uses for control-flow integrity at runtime.

details.heading: Problem
details.body: Hardware components should only be reachable from valid execution contexts, which means knowing those contexts ahead of time.

details.heading: My part
details.body: The static-analysis tooling: the Ghidra plugin and its CFG export. DECAF is the QEMU-based full-system introspection platform, built with a collaborator.

summary: A Ghidra plugin that statically analyses control flow and computes the valid execution contexts for critical functions. Its output lets DECAF, a QEMU-based introspection platform, enable or disable hardware components at runtime.
